summary: Former Gila County, AZ lookout site in the Tonto NF, listed as a gone tower; no build, staffing or fire history in readable sources.

facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists a tower that is gone; Peakbagging labels the site LO site, meaning the building is removed or its status is unknown

listed in Gila County as a tower, now gone
Peakbagging table lists Madera Peak (LO site) at 6,647 ft with a benchmark

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Forest Lookouts page gives only the name and agency. The FFLA list gives county, type (tower) and status (gone). Peakbagging Table 1 gives the LO site elevation (6647 ft, benchmark) and the key. No build date, design, staffing or fire history appears in any readable source, so none is written. Access and the site today are unknown and the story says so. The story is below the 120-word floor because readable sources support no more. NHLR and FFLOS have no Madera page in the crawl (404). A HikeArizona page (hikearizona.com/decoder.php?ZTN=1239) returns 403 to fetch_text. A search snippet from it describes remains of a 40-foot wooden tower, but it is not quoted here because it cannot be checked against a readable page. Worth a re-read by someone who can open it. This tower used more than the 6-read budget while looking for a fuller source.
